about: Demos of the library that the Ferrite desktop does not deploy: they are not apps a cloud platform can make real. Their demo folders and documentation pages stay in the library, and the library's own desktop page still hosts them. The Ferrite build of the desktop (VITE_MACALICIOUS_API=1, docs/desktop/vite.config.ts) leaves them out, and the server's catalogue (src/apps/catalogue.rs) does not list them.

apps.reason: Configures Wi-Fi base stations on the local network; an app has no sockets and egress refuses private addresses.
Partitions a disk and installs Windows; nothing of it can run on a cloud platform.
Its purpose is disks, volumes and partitions, which an app does not have; the drive's usage is Storage Management's.
